notes: Probe: 'own lakefront property' 0.97 (but 'lakefront property' without owner 0.41), 'what wheels did you get' 0.60, 'your current coffee machine' 0.35, 'your wife' 0.32; 'your plugins folder' 0.03, 'what weather did you have' 0.16.
